findings.title: ST06-R02 still uses frame timing to infer application completion
findings.rationale: At web-app/e2e/channel-transport.spec.ts:96-100, response.finished() establishes network completion, while two requestAnimationFrame callbacks establish rendering opportunities. Neither observes completion of the application's res.text() promise at api.ts:71 or the awaiting Inbox.responder continuation. Both final assertions already hold before release, so they can pass if renderer-side body processing completes later. The executor-reported guard-removal failure demonstrates sensitivity in that execution, but does not establish the required ordering for every green run. This remains a source-level protection gap at the changed R02 synchronization locus under D10 and the round2 adjudication.
findings.suggested_action: Use test-side browser instrumentation to observe settlement of the matching application's response-body read and synchronize past its responder continuation before asserting draft preservation and absence of alerts. Preserve production DTOs/routes, repeat the guard-removal control, and validate the exact restored candidate through canonical browser/all.
